_comment: English body for beautiful-ai; generated from the Chinese dossier and official pages, not a literal translation.

axes.model_access: Driven by Beautiful.ai’s generative presentation capabilities; the specific model is not disclosed item by item on the product page, and features vary by tier.
axes.runtime: Runs in Beautiful.ai’s cloud, primarily in the browser; generation and rendering happen server-side.
axes.local_files: Can upload images, brand assets and document outlines; local files must be uploaded first. Local files usually need upload or authorised access, so confirm storage location, retention and deletion before processing.
axes.background: Presentation generation and layout happen within a session; there is no background agent that survives shutdown. Tasks are triggered per request and no resident agent remains; long work must be split into reviewable steps.
axes.tools: Integrated with the presentation editor, template library, brand themes and team sharing; can export PPT and PDF.
axes.context: Context is mainly the current presentation, template and brand settings; cross-project memory is limited. Cross-document and cross-session memory is limited, so complex work needs manual context and source citations.
axes.permissions: Commercial use and asset copyright follow the tier and official terms; team template permissions are controlled by admins.
axes.fit: Fits: fast first drafts for sales, marketing and internal reporting. Does not fit: complex animation, custom charts or print-grade layout control.

related: Both generate presentations from prompts; Gamma leans toward document-to-deck and web publishing, Beautiful.ai toward brand-consistent slide layout.
Both are design-first presentation tools; Canva Magic Studio has a broader design surface, Beautiful.ai is narrower and more slide-centric.
Beautiful.ai and Google Slides Gemini both help draft decks; compare template control and export fidelity.
